root_cause.text: Missing validation of the received work completion byte length (`wc->byte_len`) in `isert_login_recv_done()` allows it to be smaller than `ISER_HEADERS_LEN`, causing an integer underflow when calculating `login_req_len` and a subsequent out-of-bounds `memcpy`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff adds a check `if (unlikely(wc->byte_len < ISER_HEADERS_LEN))` in `isert_login_recv_done()` to reject short login PDUs before calculating `isert_conn->login_req_len = wc->byte_len - ISER_HEADERS_LEN`.
